    tokens = list(case['tokens'])
    calls = case['calls']
    # Validate required fields (assume present)
    # Sort candidates: descending score, ascending start, ascending call_id
    candidates = sorted(calls, key=lambda c: (-c['score'], c['start'], c['call_id']))
    selected = []
    # Greedy selection with overlap check
    for c in candidates:
        overlap = False
        c_start, c_end = c['start'], c['end']
        for s in selected:
            s_start, s_end = s['start'], s['end']
            if c_start < s_end and s_start < c_end:  # intervals overlap
                overlap = True
                break
        if not overlap:
            selected.append(c)
    # Order accepted by source start ascending
    selected.sort(key=lambda c: c['start'])
    selected_call_ids = [c['call_id'] for c in selected]
    # Apply replacements from right to left to avoid offset shift
    for c in sorted(selected, key=lambda c: c['start'], reverse=True):
        start = c['start']
        end = c['end']
        replacement = c['replacement_tokens']
        tokens[start:end] = replacement
    return {'selected_call_ids': selected_call_ids, 'tokens': tokens}"}
